inputs: Prefer the authenticated existing fabricated full25 baseline state/tensors, with original failed tree preserved; root must pin all required descriptors. No study family input.

baseline.expected_result: Measure actual anchor availability, strict True repeats, arithmetic criterion and exact saved fabricated metric; PASS is conditional and not presumed.

required_cases: No historical matching vector in any predeclared slot: unavailable, no numerical error claim or public summary.
False anchor mismatches but a predeclared True vector matches historical digest: legitimate authenticated reference, original False mismatch remains recorded, no extra calls.
Pools authenticate from different fixed call labels: both hashes exact, assemble only canonical authenticated pools; no approximate reference.
True1/True2 byte mismatch with equal metrics: strict repeat gate fails.
Candidate/reference element just outside unchanged dtype-derived arithmetic criterion: arithmetic gate fails even if Hits50 equals.
Within arithmetic criterion but changed exact Hits50 due to strict shared-pool tie/ranking: metric gate fails.
Wrong snapshot/Adam/RNG/flag tree, wrong selected-bank alias/order, graph/mode/pool/coverage, or reordered query rows: original contracts fail.
Source/release/data/tensor/checkpoint mutation and post-accounting mutation: final custody/accounting failure suppresses public values.
Incomplete/failed/duplicate family and any one failed cell: all25 slots retained, public metrics/contrasts null.
Attempt to supply old failed qualification or single-cell diagnostic instead of fresh successor qualification: release rejected.
reference_arrays: Retain current full arrays only inside process for actual differences/assert_close; export scalar receipts, not tensor bodies.
profiling_scope: strict True does not certify third-party sparse/scatter kernels automatically; actual whole-core repeat gate and fresh qualification are required.
